note: The principles or standards that a person or society considers important and uses to guide decisions.

senses.m: The principles or standards that a person or society considers important and uses to guide decisions
senses.pat: a personal value system · share a value system · value-system change
ex: The survey asked participants about their value system.
Khảo sát hỏi người tham gia về hệ giá trị của họ.
The two groups have different value systems.
Hai nhóm có hệ giá trị khác nhau.

note: A senior naval officer rank, generally below admiral and above rear admiral in some navies; rank structure varies by country.

senses.m: A senior naval officer rank, generally below admiral and above rear admiral in some navies
senses.pat: a vice admiral in the navy · promote to vice admiral · vice-admiral rank
ex: The vice admiral inspected the fleet.
Phó đô đốc kiểm tra hạm đội.
She was promoted to vice admiral after years of service.
Bà được thăng hàm phó đô đốc sau nhiều năm phục vụ.

note: A police unit dealing with offenses such as illegal gambling or prostitution; category and powers differ by jurisdiction and the term may be dated.

senses.m: A police unit dealing with offenses such as illegal gambling or prostitution
senses.pat: a vice-squad investigation · police vice squad · vice-squad officer
ex: The vice squad investigated illegal gambling.
Đội cảnh sát chuyên trách điều tra hoạt động cờ bạc trái phép.
The article describes the history of the city’s vice squad.
Bài báo mô tả lịch sử đội cảnh sát chuyên trách của thành phố.

note: The highest British military decoration for valor in the face of the enemy; abbreviated VC.

senses.m: The highest British military decoration for valor in the face of the enemy
senses.pat: award the Victoria Cross · receive a Victoria Cross · Victoria Cross recipient
ex: He received the Victoria Cross for his actions in battle.
Ông được trao Huân chương Thập tự Victoria vì hành động trong trận chiến.
The museum displays a Victoria Cross medal.
Bảo tàng trưng bày Huân chương Thập tự Victoria.

note: A nurse who provides care by visiting patients in their homes or community settings; role and credentials vary by health system.

senses.m: A nurse who provides care by visiting patients in their homes or community settings
senses.pat: a visiting nurse service · see a visiting nurse · visiting-nurse program
ex: A visiting nurse checked on the patient at home.
Điều dưỡng đến thăm khám kiểm tra bệnh nhân tại nhà.
The clinic arranged a visiting nurse for the recovery period.
Phòng khám sắp xếp điều dưỡng đến chăm sóc trong thời gian hồi phục.

note: A computer screen or monitor, especially in British and technical usage; abbreviated VDU.

senses.m: A computer screen or monitor, especially in British and technical usage
senses.pat: a VDU screen · visual-display-unit workstation · look at the visual display unit
ex: The operator read the data on the visual display unit.
Nhân viên vận hành đọc dữ liệu trên màn hình máy tính.
The manual explains how to adjust the VDU brightness.
Hướng dẫn giải thích cách chỉnh độ sáng màn hình.

note: The area a person can see while looking straight ahead without moving the eyes; also a measured area in vision testing.

senses.m: The area a person can see while looking straight ahead without moving the eyes
senses.pat: peripheral visual field · visual-field test · loss of visual field
ex: The doctor tested her peripheral visual field.
Bác sĩ kiểm tra thị trường ngoại vi của cô.
A visual-field test can detect some changes in vision.
Kiểm tra thị trường có thể phát hiện một số thay đổi về thị lực.

note: A classified advertisement offering a job or seeking a product or service; US English. British equivalents include job ad or situations vacant notice.

senses.m: A classified advertisement offering a job or seeking a product or service
senses.pat: place a want ad · answer a want ad · newspaper want ads
ex: The shop placed a want ad for a mechanic.
Cửa hàng đăng quảng cáo tuyển thợ máy.
He found the job through a want ad in the paper.
Anh tìm được việc qua mục tuyển dụng trên báo.

note: A military rank above noncommissioned officer ranks and below commissioned officers in many forces; exact status varies.

senses.m: A military rank above noncommissioned officer ranks and below commissioned officers in many forces
senses.pat: a warrant officer in the army · promote someone to warrant officer · warrant-officer rank
ex: The warrant officer supervised the technical team.
Chuẩn úy giám sát đội kỹ thuật.
She served as a warrant officer for twenty years.
Bà phục vụ với cấp bậc chuẩn úy trong hai mươi năm.

note: A day set aside for washing clothes, especially in older household routines; British and historical usage.

senses.m: A day set aside for washing clothes, especially in older household routines
senses.pat: Monday is washing day · do the washing on washing day · traditional washing day
ex: In the novel, Monday was the family’s washing day.
Trong tiểu thuyết, thứ Hai là ngày giặt giũ của gia đình.
The household planned its chores around washing day.
Gia đình sắp xếp việc nhà theo ngày giặt giũ.

note: Powdered detergent used for washing clothes; British English. US English usually laundry detergent or detergent powder.

senses.m: Powdered detergent used for washing clothes
senses.pat: a box of washing powder · add washing powder · washing-powder dose
ex: Add the washing powder to the machine’s detergent drawer.
Cho bột giặt vào ngăn chất tẩy của máy.
The label gives the recommended washing-powder dose.
Nhãn ghi liều lượng bột giặt khuyến nghị.

note: A container for rubbish or recyclable waste; British English. US English often trash can or wastebasket, depending on size.

senses.m: A container for rubbish or recyclable waste
senses.pat: put waste in the bin · an office waste bin · empty the waste bin
ex: Please put the paper in the recycling waste bin.
Vui lòng bỏ giấy vào thùng rác tái chế.
The cleaner emptied the office waste bins.
Nhân viên vệ sinh đổ các thùng rác văn phòng.

note: A large container that collects rainwater from a roof gutter for later use; British English.

senses.m: A large container that collects rainwater from a roof gutter for later use
senses.pat: install a water butt · collect rain in a water butt · water-butt tap
ex: They installed a water butt beside the shed.
Họ lắp thùng hứng nước mưa cạnh nhà kho.
The gardener used water from the water butt on dry days.
Người làm vườn dùng nước trong thùng hứng vào những ngày khô hạn.

note: A room or small compartment containing a toilet; abbreviated WC, especially in signs and British usage.

senses.m: A room or small compartment containing a toilet
senses.pat: use the water closet · a public water closet · WC sign
ex: The station has a water closet near the platform.
Nhà ga có nhà vệ sinh gần sân ga.
The sign marked the entrance to the water closet.
Biển báo chỉ lối vào nhà vệ sinh.

note: An aquatic plant with floating leaves and flowers, usually in the family Nymphaeaceae; distinct from lotus in many botanical classifications.

senses.m: An aquatic plant with floating leaves and flowers, usually in the family Nymphaeaceae
senses.pat: a water lily blooms · water-lily pond · water lily leaves
ex: A white water lily floated on the pond.
Một bông súng trắng nổi trên ao.
The pond is covered with water-lily leaves.
Mặt ao phủ đầy lá súng.

note: A tall structure that stores water and maintains pressure in a distribution system.

senses.m: A tall structure that stores water and maintains pressure in a distribution system
senses.pat: a municipal water tower · fill the water tower · water-tower tank
ex: The town’s water tower stands above the old railway station.
Tháp nước của thị trấn nằm phía trên ga đường sắt cũ.
Workers inspected the water tower for leaks.
Công nhân kiểm tra tháp nước xem có rò rỉ không.

note: A map showing meteorological conditions such as pressure, fronts, precipitation, or temperature.

senses.m: A map showing meteorological conditions such as pressure, fronts, precipitation, or temperature
senses.pat: read a weather map · weather-map symbols · a satellite weather map
ex: The presenter used a weather map to explain the storm.
Người dẫn chương trình dùng bản đồ thời tiết để giải thích cơn bão.
The weather map shows a cold front moving east.
Bản đồ thời tiết cho thấy một front lạnh đang di chuyển về phía đông.

note: Having eaten enough or being adequately nourished; can also describe an animal or person who appears plump.

senses.m: Having eaten enough or being adequately nourished
senses.pat: keep someone well fed · a well-fed child · well-fed livestock
ex: The rescue team kept the animals warm and well fed.
Đội cứu hộ giữ ấm và cho các con vật ăn đầy đủ.
The well-fed dog had plenty of energy.
Con chó được ăn no có rất nhiều năng lượng.

note: Speaking clearly and in a manner considered articulate or socially polished; judgments can reflect cultural expectations.

senses.m: Speaking clearly and in a manner considered articulate or socially polished
senses.pat: be well spoken · a well-spoken presenter · well-spoken and confident
ex: The candidate was calm and well spoken.
Ứng viên bình tĩnh và nói năng lưu loát.
She is well spoken but avoids overly formal language.
Cô nói năng lưu loát nhưng tránh dùng ngôn ngữ quá kiểu cách.

note: A small playhouse for children, often made of wood and placed in a garden; British English, from the character Wendy in Peter Pan.

senses.m: A small playhouse for children, often made of wood and placed in a garden
senses.pat: play in a Wendy house · a wooden Wendy house · children’s Wendy house
ex: The children played in a Wendy house in the garden.
Bọn trẻ chơi trong căn nhà gỗ nhỏ ngoài vườn.
They painted the Wendy house bright yellow.
Họ sơn căn nhà chơi của trẻ màu vàng tươi.
